_note: Strings intentionally NOT translated. audit-menu-drift.py skips these when reporting new English menu strings after an upstream rebase. Keep this list SHORT: add a string only when you have decided it must stay English (brand/protocol names, raw numbers, key tokens). Adding a real UI word here hides drift -- prefer translating it into gpu/vk/menu_zh.json instead.

_fields.prefix: skipped if the string starts with any of these
_fields.numeric_only: skip pure numbers / percentages / frame rates / nits / GB / x-multipliers
_fields.printf_format_strings: skip strings containing a printf conversion (%d %s %f %% etc.) -- these are format templates, handled by the format-string entries in menu_zh.json, not standalone labels
